Working Title: America 250 Quiz: Test yourself on presidents, power and pivotal moments
Question: Who was the first president of the United States?
Answer Explanation / Fun Fact: George Washington became the first U.S. president in 1789 and remains the only president unanimously chosen by the Electoral College.

Working Title: America 250 Quiz: Test yourself on presidents, power and pivotal moments
Question: Who was the first president to live in the White House?
Answer Explanation / Fun Fact: John Adams moved into the unfinished Executive Mansion in 1800. George Washington selected the site but never lived there.

Working Title: America 250 Quiz: Test yourself on presidents, power and pivotal moments
Question: Which president approved the Louisiana Purchase in 1803?
Answer Explanation / Fun Fact: Thomas Jefferson's administration purchased the Louisiana Territory from France, dramatically expanding the size of the United States.

Working Title: America 250 Quiz: Test yourself on presidents, power and pivotal moments
Question: Which president delivered the Gettysburg Address?
Answer Explanation / Fun Fact: Abraham Lincoln delivered the Gettysburg Address in 1863, dedicating a cemetery at the Pennsylvania battlefield.

Working Title: America 250 Quiz: Test yourself on presidents, power and pivotal moments
Question: Which president served more than two terms in office?
Answer Explanation / Fun Fact: Franklin D. Roosevelt was elected four times. The 22nd Amendment later limited presidents to two elected terms.

Working Title: America 250 Quiz: Test yourself on presidents, power and pivotal moments
Question: Which president was nicknamed "Old Hickory"?
Answer Explanation / Fun Fact: Andrew Jackson earned the nickname "Old Hickory" from soldiers who compared his toughness to hickory wood.

Working Title: America 250 Quiz: Test yourself on presidents, power and pivotal moments
Question: Which president had been a Hollywood actor before entering national politics?
Answer Explanation / Fun Fact: Ronald Reagan appeared in films and television before serving as California governor and later as the 40th president.

Working Title: America 250 Quiz: Test yourself on presidents, power and pivotal moments
Question: Which president signed the Emancipation Proclamation?
Answer Explanation / Fun Fact: Abraham Lincoln issued the Emancipation Proclamation during the Civil War; it took effect on Jan. 1, 1863.

Working Title: America 250 Quiz: Test yourself on presidents, power and pivotal moments
Question: Who was the youngest person ever elected president of the United States?
Answer Explanation / Fun Fact: John F. Kennedy was 43 when elected in 1960. Theodore Roosevelt became president at 42 after William McKinley's assassination, but he was not first elected at that age.

Working Title: America 250 Quiz: Test yourself on presidents, power and pivotal moments
Question: Which president signed the act creating the National Park Service in 1916?
Answer Explanation / Fun Fact: Woodrow Wilson signed the Organic Act in 1916, establishing the National Park Service within the Department of the Interior.
